name: DexHand021 S
summary: DexHand021 S is DexRobot's three-finger hand for grasping research, robot integration and automation prototyping. description.en: DexHand021 S is DexRobot's three-finger hand for grasping research, robot integration and automation prototyping. It combines gears, tendons and linkages across eight degrees of freedom, with a manufacturer-listed mass of 0.6 kg. A palm-mounted 5 MP RGB camera and joint-position sensing are standard; normal force, tangential force and proximity sensing are configuration options. CAN FD and RS485 interfaces support integration, while an open SDK enables application development. The manufacturer describes adaptive grasping, visual guidance and compliant assembly as intended uses, with performance figures measured under laboratory conditions.
